item.title: Trump approval rating hits career low of 32% amid Iran war, high costs
item.description: Republican support for Trump dips to 73 percent, down from 82 percent, as war and inflation concerns dominate polls.

item.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war

item.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
item.description: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
